All available at runtime. **(inlined)** = section is in this prompt; **(used here)** = this
app's code already calls it. For a section not inlined, read `.vistaclair/api/<key>.md`
BEFORE using it — app-lint checks (`unread-capability`). Advertise what you use in
`manifest.json` → `capabilities` (`npm run infer:capabilities -- <appDir> --write`).

- `fs` — `fs.read/write/list/exists` — app-directory-scoped file access
- `exec` — `exec`, `spawn`, `spawn.kill` — shell commands and long-running processes
- `cron` — per-app `cron.schedule/cancel/list` — persistent recurring jobs
- `jobs` — `ctx.jobs.start/get/list/cancel`, `job:update` events — reload-resilient work
- `ai` — `ai.prompt`/`ai.models`/`ai.usage`, `pickModel`, `askAI`, `parseAIResponse`
- `cli` — `cli.edit`, `cli.workspace` — Claude Code in the app or workspaces
- `db` — `db.query`, `db.status`, `ctx.dbQuery` — per-app MariaDB
- `state` — `state.get/set` — small iframe-only preferences; not readable from routes.js
- `settings` — `settings.get/all` — user configuration (`persist-key`)
- `secrets` — `secrets.get/set` — encrypted at rest
- `files` — `ctx.files.saveBase64/serve` — uploads and range-served downloads
- `http` — `http.fetch` — server-side fetch, private addresses blocked
- `notify` — `toast.show` / `showToast` — dashboard-level toasts with history
- `dialogs` — `showConfirm`, `showModal` (host overlays) and `<vc-dialog>` (in-iframe)
- `tasks` — `tasks.list/kill` — inspect and stop spawned processes
- `events` — `Bridge.on/subscribe`, `ctx.broadcaster`; bus `ctx.events`/`Bridge.bus`
- `ui` — `<vc-input-bar>`, `<vc-chat-log>`, `<vc-progress>`, `<vc-dialog>`…
- `tools` — register AI-callable tools; `expose: self|platform|apps`
- `artifacts` — `vc-artifact://` file refs for tool results
- `identity` — `ctx.identity` — one user across dashboard session and Telegram mini-app
- `capabilities` — `ctx.capabilities.has/list` — feature-detect this platform
- `audio` — `ai.transcribe/tts/image/sfx/translate/detect` — speech, sfx, images
- `music` — `ai.music.generate/analyze/status` — local MusicGen (optional extra)
- `maps` — `ai.route/geocode/places/streetview/tiles3d` — Google maps
- `web-search` — `ai.webSearch` — live web/news/video search via Brave Search
- `embeddings` — `embed` — local 384-dim vectors
- `memory` — `memory.remember/rememberBatch/recall` — shared knowledge store
- `google` — `auth.google.getToken/accounts` — non-mail Google APIs
- `email` — `accounts.email.*`, `email.list/get/send/…` — always-synced master mail store
- `calendar` — `calendar.events/get/create/update/delete` — synced Google Calendar
- `todos` — `todos.list/create/complete/…` — platform-owned user todos/reminders
- `browser` — `browser.screenshot` — headless page render
- `telegram` — `telegram.status/send/…` + Web App (mini-app)
- `whatsapp` — `whatsapp.status/send/sendButtons/sendList/…`
- `apps` — `ctx.apps.access(app)` — another app's bot/number/URL
- `sites` — `ctx.sites` — own web servers per app
- `analytics` — `ctx.analytics` — site stats, no IPs stored
- `licensing` — `ctx.license` is free-tier only; paid content needs a licence app
- `platform-cron` — `platform.cron.schedule/list` — cross-app persistent jobs
- `sysmon` — `sysmon.get/subscribe/processes` — host RAM/CPU/disk; `<vc-sysmon>`
- `print` — `print.status/pdf` — print a PDF
- `governance` — `governance.propose/list/decide/registerKind` — owner approvals
- `spend` — `spend.status` / `ctx.spendStatus()` — the policy in force
- `fleet` — `ctx.fleet` — slaves, specs, data publish, remote calls
- `config` — Named configurations — platform-side, no app API

Not capabilities, same dir: `api/routes-ctx.md` (routes.js setup, loader ctx, OAuth
redirect, own-process), `api/toolchains.md` (Android, Blender, Rust, Godot, Unity), `migration.md`
(code the platform replaces — read it first), `platform-request.md` / `app-request.md`
(asking for a surface), `scaffolds.md`, `appmd-format.md`, `api-reference.md` (all; large).
